mods.description: MCEndgame is a Minecraft mod that aims to make Minecraft's endgame more engaging through repeatable dungeon content, meaningful gear progression, and ARPG-inspired itemization.

releases.notes:
## Features
- Reworked the damage system: damage output is unchanged, but the new system is less invasive and compatible with more mods
- Leaving a dungeon now returns you to the position of the portal you entered through
- Added a flat projectile damage attribute
- Fixed Beastweaver shader issues on some client configurations
- Some other bug fixes

## What's Changed
* Exit dungeons at the portal that was entered by @maucon in https://github.com/maucon/MCEndgame/pull/360
* Fix debug info screen sync by @maucon in https://github.com/maucon/MCEndgame/pull/361
* New damage system by @maucon in https://github.com/maucon/MCEndgame/pull/363
* Damage Debug by @maucon in https://github.com/maucon/MCEndgame/pull/366
* Fix Beastweaver Shader  by @Moewe342 in https://github.com/maucon/MCEndgame/pull/368
* Add flat projectile attack damage by @maucon in https://github.com/maucon/MCEndgame/pull/367
* Fix Arachne Projectile Damage by @Moewe342 in https://github.com/maucon/MCEndgame/pull/369
* Release 1.8.0 by @maucon in https://github.com/maucon/MCEndgame/pull/370


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/maucon/MCEndgame/compare/v1.7.1+26.3...v1.8.0+26.3

releases.notes:
## Features
* Added new dungeon enemies: **Bandits** — player-like enemies with custom loadouts that drop new **Synthesized Crystals** on defeat
* Added new bandit- and elite-related aspects
* Updated uniques with new attributes and balance changes
* Increased elite spawn rate
* Added player totem loadout to analytics
* Removed non-English translations because they weren't "optimal" 💀
